- [Unit-Economics Playbook for Small-Ticket Fintech & BNPL Defaults (₹5,000–₹1,00,000)](https://www.legalrecovery.in/small-ticket-digital-personal-loan-bnpl-recovery-economics): Unit-positive 3-wave recovery playbook combining BSA s.63 digital advocate notices, 30-day CICRA pre-adverse reporting alerts, selective Speed Post RPAD, and Section 29B batch ODR arbitration.

- [Commercial Vehicle & Construction Equipment Finance Recovery for NBFCs](https://www.legalrecovery.in/commercial-vehicle-construction-equipment-finance-recovery-nbfc): Institutional NBFC playbook for pre-seizure loan recall, Arbitration Act Section 9 ex-parte Court Receiver orders, Vahan Form 36 RC transfer under MV Act s.51(5), and post-sale Loss-on-Sale deficit suits.

- [Enterprise Collection SaaS vs Advocate-Backed Bulk Legal Desk for Mid-Market NBFCs](https://www.legalrecovery.in/credgenics-spocto-alternative-mid-market-nbfc-legal-notice-platform): CFO comparison of Credgenics/Spocto enterprise collection SaaS suites vs LegalRecovery.in's zero-lock-in Advocates Act 1961 Advocate Notice + Email/WATI WhatsApp/Speed Post RPAD + Reply Triage engine.

- [Neutral ODR & Online Arbitration Clause Drafting for NBFCs & Fintechs (Post-CORE 5-Judge Bench)](https://www.legalrecovery.in/neutral-odr-online-arbitration-clause-drafting-fintech-nbfc): General Counsel statutory guide on Section 12(5) Arbitration Act compliance after the Nov 2024 5-Judge Supreme Court CORE ruling, 6-part institutional ODR clause drafting, Seat vs. Virtual Venue separation, and Section 34/36 defense pre-emption.

- [Section 25 e-NACH Bounce Notice & Filing Deadline Calculator](https://www.legalrecovery.in/tools/section-25-nach-bounce-limitation-calculator): Interactive PSS Act 2007 s.25(1) & s.28 calculator for NBFCs and fintechs computing 30-day notice cut-offs, electronic vs RPAD deemed-service dates, 15-day cure expiry, and batch CSV Magistrate complaint deadlines.
